r.s: Library that makes it easy to build console style tables
r.d: Provides a Console_Table class with methods such as addRow(), insertRow(), addCol() etc. to build console tables with or without headers and with user defined table rules, padding, and alignment.
r.n: * Fix warning with PHP 7 and bump required PHP version to 5.2.0 (Pieter Frenssen PR #13).
